'''Nagnol''' was a gas which disrupted sensory equipment in [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. It took the form of a thick cloud of smoke that curiously expanded and moved in the vacuum of [[Realspace/Legends|space]].

The [[Jekk'Jekk Tarr]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] was once a ventilation system for passing the nagnol gasses from the docks.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] used this gas to disturb the sensors of a band of space [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] attacking the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] he was stationed onboard.
